content.title: Actual open replay and same-execution reference control checked
content.text:
Eight public statements in seven modules now pass all five public gates: actual optional reclosure of an OPEN source-row product to original stored U; reset/swap transfer under the real outer query prefix and original fuel; both source-specific auxiliary cutoff queries through actual warm/evaluated calls; original Top-field allocation and ordered open-row input replay; exact physical row children/key derived from the SAME actual physical trace; open-child Mu parent returning original U at the SAME full middle state; and reference control receipts split from ONE completed execution. Three unchanged private helpers are exported. Every old public header remains exact; 6026 of 6027 prior non-Audit sources are byte-exact, with one visibility-only file. Source: 6035 files, 5035 Audit imports. Eleven independent probes; 278 explicit reports (275 standard, three axiom-free); axiom dependencies checked for 96919 MicroCFTA theorems. Only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. Pinned Nix, one Lean thread, 8 GiB high/max, swap zero; source hashes stable.

Scope: exact child replay and physical Trace inputs remain real smaller-body/source induction obligations. Prefix existence, source ancestry, admission and original height descent remain open. Do not infer exact rows/markers/cutoffs from only-U atoms. The same Returned-law history from literal empty memo tables is still open; the corrected closed-domain and exact OPEN auxiliary family audit remains necessary. No future semantic model, full-goal provider or second cache framework was substituted.

The complete target remains ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original emitted root under ONE assignment satisfying native domains, paths, aliases, residuals and EVERY same-output historical removed obligation, with original source/root/noStop/budgets/all outcomes/earlier emissions preserved. Structural completion does not discharge removed paths. No Haskell/Cabal/Liquid changes or runtime bug/fix claimed. Raw failed candidates, full headers, repairs and diagnostics are retained. Private compiler objects were removed only after all public replacements passed; readable /tmp about 485 MB. Goal ACTIVE; compact checkpoint follows.
